messages:
anika: opening follow-up for Shoreline Dedicated incident. brief recap: VPC peering flapped + on-prem load-balancer reset sessions; customer routes were slow to re-advertise causing ~1h30m isolation. need owners for fixes, onboarding gates, and a fast-detect rule. tagging @peter @devon @sarah.

peter: saw BGP logs: peer lost adjacency during LB restart and then re-advertised only a subset of prefixes. suspect partial route-reinjection from their device. will prepare a config diff to adjust hold timers and include route-refresh steps.

devon: I'll own detection + playbook. plan: synthetic prefix check every 30s, require 2 consecutive misses + mgmt-unreachable confirmation before paging. auto-collect bgp snapshots + tcpdump on triggers. prototype ETA 2026-04-06.

sarah: customer notes: Shoreline runs vendor-LB v5.4 known to reset sessions on restart. they agreed to a staging probe; also shared their mgmt ACLs which briefly blocked our mgmt during the event. suggest adding "mgmt-exemptions" check in onboarding.

anika: draft actions (owner -> ETA):
- peter -> PR: hold-timer + route-refresh plan -> 2026-03-31
- devon -> synthetic check + playbook -> 2026-04-06
- sarah -> customer coordination + staging canary plan -> 2026-04-05
- infra -> onboarding field: mgmt-exemptions + LB image -> 2026-04-10
- ops -> update runbook: mgmt-fallback + escalation timeline -> 2026-04-03

peter: lab note: lowering timers to 3/9 cut reconverge from ~70s -> ~12s in sim. enabling graceful-restart where supported removed some stale-reinject cases. will mark vendor compatibility in PR.

devon: added small snippet for auto-collect: ``` poll_peer(); if missing >2 then collect(bgp_snapshot, mgmt_ping, tcpdump); page_oncall(); ``` will link PR. tuned thresholds in staging to reduce noise.

sarah: staging canary scheduled 2026-04-08 02:00-03:00 UTC on one PoP. will run pre/post checks and report. shorelline ops agreed to upgrade LB in canary.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-04-02-721 created: Shoreline Dedicated peering isolation follow-ups added. link: https://incidents.redwood/2026/721

infra-bot: task created: SHORE-2026-FU assigned to infra-team. reminder 2026-04-07.

anika: plan to reconvene 2026-04-09 11:00 PT to close items. if we see similar LB+GR patterns across tenants, escalate to platform guardrail and prioritize a bulk tenant sweep. closing thread for now, will reopen with PR links and canary logs. :thumbsup:
